title: What does a ratio like 2 to 3 really mean?
examples: Is a ratio the same as a fraction?
How do I scale up a recipe ratio?

explain.say: Imagine you make mango lassi in Mumbai. You use 2 cups of mango for every 3 cups of yogurt. That is the ratio 2 to 3. See the two bars? One is mango, one is yogurt.

draw.text: What does a ratio like 2 to 3 really mean?

items.label: Mango 2 cups
items.ask: Does the order of a ratio matter?

explain.say: A ratio compares one part with another part. Look at the mango bar: 2 cups. For every 2 cups of mango, you always add 3 cups of yogurt. Which is the bigger part?

items.label: Mango 2 cups
items.ask: Does the order of a ratio matter?

explain.say: Now count all the parts: 2 plus 3 is 5 parts. The top bar shows mango as 2 of the 5 parts. The bottom bar shows yogurt as 3 of the 5 parts. So mango is two fifths of the drink.
Friends coming over? Double both parts: 4 cups of mango and 6 cups of yogurt. The bars grow, but the taste stays the same. 4 to 6 is still 2 to 3. Can you see why?

You have got it! Triple it and you get 6 cups to 9 cups. Ratios are everywhere: about 1 cup of rice to 2 cups of water, or a map where 1 centimetre stands for 500 metres. Challenge: 12 cups of yogurt need how much mango?

faq.q: Is a ratio the same as a fraction?
faq.a: Not quite. A ratio compares part to part, like 2 cups of mango to 3 cups of yogurt. A fraction compares a part to the whole, so mango is two fifths of the lassi.
asks: What is the difference between a ratio and a fraction?

faq.q: How do you simplify a ratio?
faq.a: Divide both parts by the same number. 4 to 6 divided by 2 is 2 to 3. It is the same mix, written smaller.
asks: How do you write 4:6 in simplest form?

faq.q: Does the order of a ratio matter?
faq.a: Yes. Mango to yogurt 2 to 3 is not the same as 3 to 2. Keep the numbers in the same order as the words.

faq.q: How do you scale a ratio up?
faq.a: Multiply both parts by the same number. 2 to 3 times 4 is 8 to 12, so 12 cups of yogurt need 8 cups of mango.
asks: If I use 12 cups of yogurt how much mango do I need?

faq.q: What does a map scale of 1 to 50,000 mean?
faq.a: Every 1 centimetre on the map stands for 50,000 centimetres on the ground. That is 500 metres.
asks: What is a map scale ratio?

facts: A map scale of 1 : 50,000 means 1 cm on the map is 500 m on the ground.
Ratios are written with a colon, so two to three is written 2 : 3.

quiz.say: Blue and yellow paint are mixed in the ratio 2 to 3. What fraction of the paint is blue?
quiz.why: There are 2 plus 3, so 5 parts in all, and 2 of them are blue.

wrong.1: Two thirds compares blue with yellow, not with the whole.
wrong.2: Three fifths is the yellow part.

quiz.say: Which ratio is the same as 4 to 10?
quiz.why: Divide both parts of 4 to 10 by 2 and you get 2 to 5.

wrong.1: 1 to 3 does not come from dividing both parts by the same number.
wrong.2: 4 to 5 only divides the second part.
